decisions.reason: The dietary supplement range builds directly on the firm's established consumer health offer and in-house development, so management can read early results and refine the range.
The skin and hair supplement extends the established pharmacy consumer health line, has a page of its own and an active launch message, and fits the firm's related knowledge.
The joint health supplement is an extension of the established Trivital brand, so the firm's existing knowledge lets it assimilate market feedback and improve the product.

The mushroom-based immune supplement is somewhat more novel and only mentioned on the website, but it still builds on the established supplement offer, so the firm can likely learn from early results.

The generic valsartan lies far from the firm's established offer and was hit in 2018 by a contamination-related problem, and with little related knowledge to interpret and fix the issue, management is likely to withdraw it.
